inputs.text: Full-length figure from head to feet: Yama Dharmaraja, the Hindu lord of dharma, a tall dignified mature man with a calm, noble, kingly human face, round human ears, a dark moustache and steady open eyes. His skin is deep dark green like a monsoon storm cloud, the same on face, arms and hands. A low plain dark-bronze crown band rests on his eyebrows, copper earrings and a crimson silk dhoti. His right hand holds upright a plain straight dark iron staff, topped by one carved bronze water-buffalo head with short horns swept back. His left fist clutches a golden rope noose, one loop of rope hanging from his fist. Two arms. Deep green, crimson and dark bronze. Bold hand-painted 2D action-game character art with confident dark ink outlines, rich painterly detail, a strong readable silhouette and chunky heroic proportions, three-quarter top-down game sprite view, in the spirit of classical Indian temple murals. The entire figure is visible from head to feet, standing on the ground, centered, alone before a flat, even, medium-grey backdrop filling the whole image.
